subject: Evidence package: employee vetting, training, and onboarding/offboarding logs
messages:
From: Anna Schultz <anna.schultz@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor evidence request — employee vetting and training

Hi Marissa,

Acme is continuing our SIG review and we need a short bundle of artifacts related to employee vetting and training for Redwood. Specifically we are asking for:

- Copy of your background check policy and a summary (last 12 months) showing which hires had checks completed (redacted PII OK)
- Security awareness/training completion rates for the last 12 months (company-wide + contractor split)
- Onboarding & offboarding access revocation log (sample for last 30 days) and a short note on role-based access changes during offboarding
- Which checks you run for international hires/contractors (APAC focus) and how you handle vendors/contractors

Can you provide an evidence package by next Wednesday (2026-03-03)? If anything needs an NDA or separate secure transfer, let me know.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Anna Schultz
Senior Security Manager
Acme Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schultz <anna.schultz@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — employee vetting and training

Hi Anna — thanks for the detailed list. Looping in Grace (Security Compliance) and Karthik (People Ops point) so we can assemble the artifacts.

Plan: Grace will pull the training completion report and onboarding/offboarding logs; Karthik will provide the background-check policy and a redacted summary CSV. We will:
- Redact PII where appropriate
- Provide contractor vs employee breakdowns
- Include a short mapping to SOC 2 control family references (where applicable)

We should be able to deliver a secure bundle by EOD 2026-03-02. If you need anything sooner or want a scoped sample first (e.g., only APAC contractors), say so.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schultz <anna.schultz@acmeanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — employee vetting and training

Hi Anna / Marissa — attaching the requested artifacts and a few implementation notes. Attachment stubs listed below; I can upload originals to an access-controlled share if you prefer.

Attachments (in this message):
- background-check-policy.pdf (policy, redacted contact info)
- background-check-summary-2026-02.csv (CSV, candidate id, hire date, check type, result status — PII removed)
- security-training-summary-2025-2026.pdf (PDF, completion % by employee vs contractor)
- onboarding-offboarding-log-2026-02.csv (CSV sample for 2026-02; includes access revocation timestamp and owner)

Quick notes:
- Background checks: Redwood requires identity verification + criminal record check for US hires. For contractors we run risk-based checks depending on access scope; higher-risk contractors get the same checks as full-time hires. For APAC hires we follow local legal requirements and perform identity verification; criminal checks are done where permitted by local law.
- Training: All full-time staff complete a 2-hour security awareness module on hire and quarterly short refreshers; contractors complete a 1-hour onboarding training. The attached PDF shows completion rates and dates.
- Onboarding/offboarding: Access revocations are automated where possible (SAML/SCIM) and manual ticket-driven for legacy systems; the sample log includes timestamps and ticket IDs.
- SOC 2 mapping: the artifacts map to CC6.1 (HR screening) and CC7.2 (access revocation) — we can provide a short control mapping matrix on request.

If you need the original logs (they contain identifiers) we can transfer via our secure SharePoint link or a signed NDA.

—
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: security-training-summary-2025-2026.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: background-check-summary-2026-02.csv (CSV, 45KB)
Attachment: onboarding-offboarding-log-2026-02.csv (CSV, 60KB)
Attachment: background-check-policy.pdf (PDF, 110KB)
From: Anna Schultz <anna.schultz@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — employee vetting and training

Thanks Grace — this is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the SIG item:

1) For contractors: do you maintain signed statements of background-check completion from third-party vendor partners, or do you rely on vendor attestations? Can you share an example (redacted) of the vendor attestation?

2) For APAC hires: do you have a documented decision flow for when you do or do not execute criminal checks (we need to show our auditors the policy rationale vs. local law exceptions).

3) Can you confirm that access revocation is enforced within 24 hours for terminated employees in the onboarding/offboarding log? The sample shows timestamps but we want a statement of SLA.

If possible, a brief control mapping matrix (1 page) that ties artifacts to SIG/SOC2 controls would close this out.

If you prefer, we can move to a short call next week to finalize.

Best,
Anna
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schultz <anna.schultz@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T16:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — employee vetting and training

Anna — quick update and answers:

- Vendor attestations: we get vendor-signed attestations for vendors that perform background checks for us; I asked Karthik to pull an example attestation (redacted) and we will upload it to the secure drive.
- APAC decision flow: Grace will prepare a 1-page decision flow that shows when criminal checks are performed vs local-law exceptions (this will reference our global hiring playbook).
- Access revocation SLA: confirmed — Redwood's internal policy requires access revocation within 24 hours of termination for all corporate systems; the onboarding/offboarding sample reflects the automated revocations and manual tickets for legacy systems.
- Control matrix: Grace will add a 1-page mapping to SOC2/SIG controls and drop it in the secure SharePoint folder.

Related links where we'll upload final artifacts: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/employee-evidence

If you want a call to walk through the artifacts, I'm available Thursday 10–11am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor-attestation-example-redacted.pdf (will be uploaded)
